deficiencies.description: The rewrite adds the phrase "that is", which introduces a link explicitly stating that acetylation or deacetylation is the same thing as the state of transcription. The text only juxtaposes the phrases without stating this explicit link.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: to the acetylation or deacetylation, the state of the transcription within the cell itself.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: and to acetylation or deacetylation, that is, the state of transcription within the cell itself.

deficiencies.description: The rewrite changes the cause of predisposing to chronic inflammatory events from "they" (the seven human viruses) to "infection" in general, making the causal claim wider.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: There are about seven different human viruses that will precipitate cancer, and they can also predispose to chronic inflammatory events
deficiencies.rewritePassage: There are about seven different human viruses that precipitate cancer, and infection can also predispose to chronic inflammatory events

considerations.sourcePassage: small insertions to whole chromosome losses
considerations.reason: The rewrite changes 'to' into 'as well as'. While 'to' normally implies a range (e.g., from small to large), the speaker omitted 'from', turning it into a running list. 'As well as' correctly captures the additive intent without distorting the meaning.

considerations.sourcePassage: So there's a lot of changes that occur
considerations.reason: The rewrite uses 'Many changes therefore occur'. Although 'therefore' adds a causal link, the original text used 'So', which can function identically to 'therefore'. This is an allowed change of words with exactly the same meaning.

considerations.sourcePassage: we don't know pretty much because of this when they occur.
considerations.reason: The rewrite changes this to 'because of this it is largely not known when they occur'. This is a correct paraphrase that maintains the meaning.
